name: Structured Linked Data as a Memory Layer for Agent-Orchestrated Retrieval
description: This benchmark evaluates the impact of using structured linked data, including Schema.org markup and enhanced entity pages, on retrieval accuracy and answer quality in both standard and agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems across four domains.
reputation: A very new benchmark proposal with limited community adoption so far, but it targets an important retrieval setting for agentic RAG systems.
notes: Includes dataset, evaluation framework, and enhanced entity page templates for reproducibility.
